claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.direct_apply
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Prayer of Healing applies directly to chosen targets with no attack roll and no saving throw. The current ActivationPhase union only has attack_roll and save_gate. A third variant is needed for instant spells that select targets and apply effects unconditionally.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to five creatures of your choice who remain within range for the spell's entire casting gain the benefits of a Short Rest and also regain 2d8 Hit Points.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.heal_hp
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell-context Effect type is DamageEffect | NoneEffect. Prayer of Healing restores HP. The v4 atom 'heal' exists but is not wired into the spell Effect type. A heal_hp variant (parallel to HealHpEffect in ClassFeatureEffect) must be added to spell Effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: regain 2d8 Hit Points ... The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_short_rest_benefits
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Targets gain the benefits of a Short Rest — they may spend Hit Dice to recover HP and regain any short-rest class resources (Channel Divinity, Bardic Inspiration, etc.). This is a distinct mechanical effect with runtime consequences. No v4 atom covers it. It is not reducible to 'heal' since it requires the runtime to invoke the full short-rest recovery procedure on the target creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: gain the benefits of a Short Rest and also regain 2d8 Hit Points

claude_proposed_widenings.name: TargetReuseLimiter (per-target long-rest restriction)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A creature can't be affected by this spell again until it finishes a Long Rest. This is a per-target reuse restriction that lives on the recipient, not the caster. The current surface models only caster-side resource consumption (use_count reset by rest). A new surface concept is needed to express that the spell records a 'has-been-affected' flag on each target keyed to a Long Rest cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can't be affected by this spell again until that creature finishes a Long Rest.
